remarks: Welcome to 50 Aiken Street, located in the highly desirable Rolling Ridge community! This beautiful end unit offers 990 sq ft of comfortable living with an open-concept design, two spacious bedrooms, and a full bath. Positioned on the top floor of one of the community's rare two-story buildings, the home enjoys abundant natural light with triple window exposure and the added privacy of a covered deck. Lovingly maintained by long time owners and ready for your vision and updates. Practical conveniences include in-unit laundry and a dedicated basement storage area. Plenty of additional parking spaces in front of the unit allow for entertaining! Rolling Ridge residents also enjoy exceptional amenities, including a tranquil in-ground pool overlooking the pond and paddle tennis courts for recreation. Monthly common charges cover heat, hot water, and water-making this a truly hassle-free lifestyle. Perfectly situated, this quiet neighborhood retreat is just minutes from the Route 7 Connector, Merritt Parkway, and I-95, as well as premier shopping, dining, and entertainment options. This property presents a wonderful opportunity to own in one of the area's most sought-after communities.
